title: Clean Air Act section 109(b)(1): health-based air standards
shortTitle: Clean Air Act section 109(b)(1): health-based air standards
summary: The assigned provision directs EPA to set primary ambient air standards requisite to protect public health with an adequate margin of safety.
notes:
The standard-setting judgment rests on the Act’s scientific criteria documents and concerns a defined class of air pollutants. Whitman reads requisite to mean sufficient but no more than necessary and holds that the provision excludes implementation costs from this initial standard-setting calculation.

The same text supplies an intelligible principle for delegation purposes. These conclusions concern the specified statutory task; they do not establish that EPA may never consider costs elsewhere in the Clean Air Act. The record reports the provision as reproduced and interpreted in the assigned 2001 case.
